title: Stadia Field Survey Suite v1.0.0.9 Release Notes
features: 📐 Total Station A4 PDF Exporter: Redesigned with 3-Pass Virtual Segmenter Engine and neat DMS angle spacing.
🛒 Multi-Item Shopping Cart: Full-screen Items Checkout Sub-Screen with 1-hour persistent cart auto-expiry.
💳 Payment Options: Integrated Safaricom M-Pesa Xpress and Google Play Billing v7.1.1 (Consumable Sheet Handling).
🌍 Smart Region Auto-Detection: Automatic currency (KSh, USD, EUR, GBP) and default payment mode selection.
📌 MS Excel-Style Freeze Panes: Pinned Station & Target columns during horizontal observation table panning.
🔍 Pinch-to-Zoom: Pinch gesture zooming on all TS and Levelling observation tables with floating 100% Reset Pill.
⌨️ Stadia Keypad v2: Top-row navigation bar and centered live column name preview bar.
🔔 System Bar Notifications: Direct 'Open File' and 'Share' action buttons for exported PDF/CSV reports.
🎁 Promo Code Engine: Integrated BPC112026 promo code for unlimited sheet export authorization.
